title: Design System: HedgeHound · The Canis Edition

scan-cyan.purpose: Scanning, long leg, Bayer letters, focus. Never decorative.

scent-orange.purpose: Alerts and short leg only. Never decorative.

display-chapter.purpose: Chapter titles (Sniff, The Trail…), with ShimmerText.

figure.purpose: Numbers. Always next to a SourceTag.

motion.name: scroll-locked
motion.value: progress = section scroll fraction; no clock
motion.purpose: Every transition, reveal and crawl. Stops when the scroll stops.

motion.name: stardust
motion.purpose: Subtle entrance for readings and labels.

narrative.overview: A funding-spread scanner presented as a night-sky observatory. The sky is the interface; the scroll is the only clock. Built to the owner's taste: real dark sky, minimal colour, no cards, no bloom, scroll-locked bite transitions, thin Noto Serif Display with a mono.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black real sky with J2000 Canis Major

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Cyan = scanning/long, orange = alert/short. No other accents.

rules.name: The Two Fonts Rule
rules.body: Noto Serif Display + JetBrains Mono only.

rules.name: No Glow
rules.body: No bloom, halos, haze or drop shadows. Depth comes from parallax layers.

dos: Let entrances grow from where they connect
donts: No sliding masks pretending to be pixels
